visualCharacteristics.purpose: pricing explanation and price table beside a highlighted content panel

contentPattern.structure: row 1: two cells [heading + intro text | panel heading + text + list]; rows 2+: the pricing table, one row per table row with one cell per column, the first of these rows being the column headers. The table is rendered under the intro text

usage: Learning Academy pricing table beside the customized-content panel.
reuseGuidance: One-off layout; for a plain table on its own use default content.
